strategy_name: TG1x-hyst2 — BTC perp 200d-SMA gated long with 2% hysteresis

definitions.state(t): 1 if long, 0 if flat; transitions: 0->1 when close(t) > upper_band(t); 1->0 when close(t) < lower_band(t)

position_rule: w(t+1) = state(t); execute at 00:00 UTC close of day t (day t+1 open); w in {0, 1}

costs.taker: 0.05% per side on |delta w| (incl. drift rebalancing)
costs.funding: w * sum of the day's 3 funding rates; paid by long when positive

alternative_tested_variant.VT_TG: w(t+1) = min(2.0, 0.50/rv30(t)) * 1[close(t) > SMA200(t)]; full-sample Sharpe 0.821 vs 0.876 primary; OOS Sharpe 0.672 vs 0.754 primary; use only if risk-manager wants explicit vol scaling/leverage ceiling

rejected_overlays.funding_contrarian_tilt: DEAD as price alpha: train NW t<=1.6, TEST wrong sign (7d: -0.59, 30d: -0.34), tilt regression OOS t=-0.34; mechanical carry benefit (+1.2-3.7%/yr) < churn cost + lost upside in composite (OOS CAGR 20.8% -> 15.6%)
rejected_overlays.taker_flow_overlay: DEAD: train t=1.74 with controls -> OOS t=0.42, OOS R2 = -0.7% to -1.9%, pred corr ~0. Coefficient collapsed 82% OOS.

known_failure_modes: whipsaw chop around SMA200 in high-funding regimes (2021: CAGR -20% even with hysteresis, -41% without; MDD -56%)
slow exit: gate exits AFTER price already fell through the band (Apr-May 2021: rode -43% before exit)
statistical fragility: gate's incremental value vs no-gate p ~ 0.14-0.25 (bootstrap); evidence base = ~2 bears
funding regime: if funding flips persistently negative while gated ON, drag becomes benefit (2026: only 1.4-1.8%/yr drag); if 2021-like (30%/yr), in-market drag ~30%/yr at 1x
